title: Highly selective hydrodeoxygenation catalyst for sustainable aviation fuel production from used cooking oil
notes_for_crosscheck: Best catalyst NiMo/Al2O3-SiO2 70:30 with 0.5 wt% P; Mo ~10 wt% then Ni ~3 wt%; calcined 550 C 5 h. Conditions: 350 C; 6 MPa (=60 bar); WHSV 1.1; H2/oil(v/v) 400. title: Evaluation of nickel supported vanadium and carbon catalyst for sustainable aviation fuel production from waste cooking oil

title: From food waste to sustainable aviation fuel: cobalt molybdenum catalysis of pretreated hydrothermal liquefaction biocrude
notes_for_crosscheck: Feedstock = pretreated food-waste HTL biocrude (not raw WCO) so feedstock_type=other. Commercial CoMo/Al2O3. Batch autoclave; Taguchi+RSM; many runs ~350-450 C.
